localizedText.WriteFailed: {failed} of {total} permissions could not be written.
localizedText.AccessInfo: Limits the access that can be inherited from the default symbol access of a user group. This limit is not enforced for user groups that set the access level for this symbol explicitly.
localizedText.GroupDefaultAccessInfo: Used if no other access level is specified for a mapped symbol. Is limited by the access level that is specified on the mapped symbol.
localizedText.InheritedPermission: Uses the group default above, restricted by Symbol access. Click to keep the resulting rights as a separate rule.
localizedText.OwnPermission: A custom rule replaces the group default and Symbol access. Click to use the group default instead.
localizedText.MixedInheritance: Some symbols use the group default, others have explicit rules. Click to use the group default for all matching symbols.
localizedText.SymbolAccessLocked: Changing Symbol access requires write access to the server configuration.
localizedText.ReadLimitAllowed: Symbol access allows inherited read access.
localizedText.ReadLimitBlocked: Symbol access blocks inherited read access. A custom group rule can override it.
localizedText.WriteLimitAllowed: Symbol access allows inherited write access.
localizedText.WriteLimitBlocked: Symbol access blocks inherited write access. A custom group rule can override it.
localizedText.FileInheritedPermission: Uses the group default above, restricted by File access. Click to keep the resulting rights as a separate rule.
localizedText.FileOwnPermission: A custom rule replaces the group default and File access. Click to use the group default instead.
localizedText.FileMixedInheritance: Some files use the group default, others have explicit rules. Click to use the group default for all matching files.
localizedText.FolderOwnPermission: A custom rule replaces the rule of {folder}. Click to use the rule of {folder} instead.
localizedText.FolderRulePermission: The rule of the folder replaces the group default and File access. Click to keep the resulting rights as a separate rule for this file.
localizedText.FolderRuleBulkPermission: The rule of the folder replaces the group default and File access. Click to keep the resulting rights as separate rules for these files.
localizedText.FileListIncomplete: Some folders could not be read. The list of files is incomplete.
localizedText.FileListFailed: The files could not be read.
localizedText.FileAccessLocked: Changing File access requires write access to the server configuration.
localizedText.FileAccessInfo: Limits the access that can be inherited from the default file access of a user group. An entry of a folder applies to every file below it. This limit is not enforced for user groups that set the access level for this file or one of its folders explicitly.
localizedText.FileGroupDefaultAccessInfo: Used if no other access level is specified for a file or one of its folders. Is limited by the File access of the file.
localizedText.FileReadLimitAllowed: File access allows inherited read access.
localizedText.FileReadLimitBlocked: File access blocks inherited read access. A custom group rule can override it.
localizedText.FileWriteLimitAllowed: File access allows inherited write access.
localizedText.FileWriteLimitBlocked: File access blocks inherited write access. A custom group rule can override it.
